title: RoboRoute
summary: A paper robot on a grid museum: lay down command tiles — forward, turn, repeat — then step through and debug.
mobileSupportNote: Full loop works at 390x844: room stacks on top, palette + program dock below; editing favors tap + toolbar over drag. Tablet remains the hero target.

cover.alt: Mission 'Spark Circuit' mid-run: the blueprint museum room with exhibits and lightning sparks, a collected spark tallied on the dock ring (1 of 3), and the program strip showing a REPEAT token executing its second of three rounds with the inner turn-left tile lit.

desktop.alt: The museum map landing screen at desktop size: a drafting title block reading ROBOROUTE - The Museum of Ways - Sheet 15, and two wing rooms (Sequence Hall missions 01-04, Loop Gallery missions 05-08) hung with mission plaques and spark pips.

tablet.alt: The same museum map landing screen at tablet size (1024x768): title block on top, Sequence Hall and Loop Gallery wing rooms side by side with their eight mission plaques.

mobile.alt: The museum map on a 390x844 phone: the ROBOROUTE title block with mission and spark tallies, followed by the Sequence Hall wing with its four mission plaques stacked vertically.
